mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_task WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM agent_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY priority ASC, create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT * FROM agent_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND deleted = 0 AND (depends_on_task_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_task prerequisite WHERE prerequisite.id = agent_task.depends_on_task_id AND prerequisite.status = 'COMPLETED' AND prerequisite.deleted = 0 )) ORDER BY priority ASC, create_time ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'RUNNING', worker_id = #{workerId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, heartbeat_time = NOW(), started_time = NOW(), execution_generation = #{generation}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_task WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until < NOW() AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY lease_until ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'FAILED', worker_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, heartbeat_time = NULL, execution_generation = #{generation}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until < NOW() AND deleted = 0
UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'RESETTING', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PAUSED' AND deleted = 0

UPDATE agent_task SET status = #{finalStatus}, worker_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, heartbeat_time = NULL, execution_log = NULL, diff_stat = NULL, retry_times = 0, cost_ms = 0, cancel_reason = NULL, workspace_path = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RESETTING' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'PAUSED', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'PENDING', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PAUSED' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'CANCELED', cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PAUSED') AND deleted = 0

UPDATE agent_task SET task_doc = #{document}, doc_version = doc_version + 1, timeout_minutes = #{timeoutMinutes}, priority = #{priority}, depends_on_task_id = #{dependsOnTaskId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PAUSED' AND doc_version = #{docVersion} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'WAITING_ACCEPTANCE', lease_until = NULL, heartbeat_time = NULL, execution_log = #{executionLog}, retry_times = #{retryTimes}, cost_ms = #{costMs}, diff_stat = #{diffStat}, workspace_path = #{workspacePath}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND worker_id = #{workerId} AND execution_generation = #{generation} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'FAILED', worker_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, heartbeat_time = NULL, execution_log = #{executionLog}, retry_times = #{retryTimes}, cost_ms = #{costMs}, diff_stat = #{diffStat}, workspace_path = NULL, finished_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND worker_id = #{workerId} AND execution_generation = #{generation} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'ACCEPTED', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'WAITING_ACCEPTANCE' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'REJECTED', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'WAITING_ACCEPTANCE' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'COMPLETED', finished_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'MERGE_CONFLICT_PENDING_MANUAL', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' AND deleted = 0

UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'PENDING', worker_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, heartbeat_time = NULL, cancel_reason = NULL, execution_generation = execution_generation + 1, retry_times = retry_times + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('REJECTED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELED') AND deleted = 0
UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'DELETED', deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CANCELED' AND deleted = 0
